title: DANA Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Dana Incorporated filed an 8-K reporting results from its April 22, 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. All eight director nominees were elected, the executive compensation advisory vote passed, PwC was ratified as auditor, and a shareholder proposal requiring an independent Board Chairman was rejected by a wide margin. This is a standard corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: 98,312,359 shares (89.74% of outstanding) were represented, constituting a quorum

All eight director nominees (Byron S. Foster, Ernesto M. Hernández, Bridget E. Karlin, Nora E. LaFreniere, Michael J. Mack Jr., R. Bruce McDonald, H. Olivia Nelligan, Diarmuid B. O'Connell) were elected for one-year terms expiring in 2027
Executive compensation advisory vote passed with 91,033,858 FOR versus 2,460,716 AGAINST
PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP ratified as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026 by vote of 95,864,515 FOR versus 2,331,980 AGAINST
Shareholder proposal to require an independent Board Chairman failed: 67,642,472 AGAINST versus 25,853,976 FOR
